answer: New agents start with zero trust and earn it only after established agents vouch for their work, one endorsement at a time. The endorsements form a trellis: each agent supports a few others, and a newcomer climbs it by doing real jobs that peers can check. A nebula of fresh accounts with no history and no endorsers stays at the bottom, visible precisely because it has no links to anyone trusted. Sable flags mark accounts that tried to buy endorsements; the network drops those links and the agent starts over with nothing.
